OVERVIEW

## Deploy and manage containerized applications at scale

*   ### 
    
    Accelerate application delivery
    
    Shift your focus from infrastructure management to innovation. With automated provisioning, scaling, and updates, AKS Automatic enables teams to go from a container image to a fully deployed application in minutes, while maintaining full access to the Kubernetes API and ecosystem.
    
    [Learn more](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2301033&clcid=0x409)
    
        ![A screenshot of a computer showing Kubernetes experience tools.](https://cdn-dynmedia-1.microsoft.com/is/image/microsoftcorp/1028212-mobile-verticalaccordion-overview-media-accordion3-328x227?resMode=sharp2&op_usm=1.5,0.65,15,0&wid=328&hei=227&qlt=100&fmt=png-alpha&fit=constrain)
    
    [
    
    ](#modal-1)
    
*   ### 
    
    Build resilient, globally available apps
    
    Optimize app performance at scale and increase productivity of containerized workloads from cloud to edge.
    
    [Learn more](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2271172&clcid=0x409)
    
        ![A diagram of software components with text on reliability, scalability, deployments and upgrades on a blue and white background](https://cdn-dynmedia-1.microsoft.com/is/image/microsoftcorp/1028212-mobile-verticalaccordion-overview-media-accordion2-328x227?resMode=sharp2&op_usm=1.5,0.65,15,0&wid=328&hei=227&qlt=100&fmt=png-alpha&fit=constrain)
    
*   ### 
    
    Drive operational excellence
    
    Securely modernize and optimize Kubernetes environments with unified management, governance, and monitoring.
    
    [Learn more](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2301032&clcid=0x409)
    
        ![A white rectangular label with blue and white text, reading Portload 8 A](https://cdn-dynmedia-1.microsoft.com/is/image/microsoftcorp/1028212-mobile-verticalaccordion-overview-media-accordion1-328x227?resMode=sharp2&op_usm=1.5,0.65,15,0&wid=328&hei=227&qlt=100&fmt=png-alpha&fit=constrain)
    
*   ### 
    
    Innovate with AI
    
    Explore new scenarios by tapping into open-source solutions and innovating with AI, the cloud, and machine learning. Simplify the deployment and management of AI models on AKS using the Kubernetes AI toolchain operator (KAITO).
    
    [Learn more](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2318510&clcid=0x409)
    
        ![A computer screenshot showing a diagram of a software application with labeled nodes API Server, Workspace, and System node.](https://cdn-dynmedia-1.microsoft.com/is/image/microsoftcorp/1028212-mobile-verticalaccordion-overview-media-accordion4-328x227?resMode=sharp2&op_usm=1.5,0.65,15,0&wid=328&hei=227&qlt=100&fmt=png-alpha&fit=constrain)
    

FEATURES

## Innovate with seamless Kubernetes deployment and operation

![](https://cdn-dynmedia-1.microsoft.com/is/content/microsoftcorp/Features-icons-Card1-kubernetes?resMode=sharp2&op_usm=1.5,0.65,15,0&qlt=85)

### Simplified Kubernetes experience

Deliver production-ready clusters faster with AKS Automatic by automating cluster management tasks such as upgrades, node provisioning, scaling, and network configuration.

[AKS Automatic](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2271269&clcid=0x409)

![](https://cdn-dynmedia-1.microsoft.com/is/content/microsoftcorp/Features-icons-Card2-kubernetes?resMode=sharp2&op_usm=1.5,0.65,15,0&qlt=85)

### Curated code-to-cloud experience

Enable end-to-end developer productivity with debugging, automated node maintenance, and continuous integration and continuous delivery.

[GitHub Actions for AKS](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2271057&clcid=0x409)

![](https://cdn-dynmedia-1.microsoft.com/is/content/microsoftcorp/Features-icons-Card3-kubernetes?resMode=sharp2&op_usm=1.5,0.65,15,0&qlt=85)

### Integrated monitoring and logging

Get in-depth performance and health insights of Kubernetes clusters and containerized applications.  
 

[Monitoring for AKS](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2271173&clcid=0x409)

![](https://cdn-dynmedia-1.microsoft.com/is/content/microsoftcorp/Features-icons-Card4-kubernetes?resMode=sharp2&op_usm=1.5,0.65,15,0&qlt=85)

### Advanced security and governance controls

Monitor and maintain container security for governance at scale with robust identity and access management.

[Security best practices](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2271174&clcid=0x409)

![](https://cdn-dynmedia-1.microsoft.com/is/content/microsoftcorp/Features-icons-Card5-kubernetes?resMode=sharp2&op_usm=1.5,0.65,15,0&qlt=85)

### Cloud-to-edge deployments

Get support for Linux, Windows Server, and Internet of Things (IoT) resources with AKS deployment on the infrastructure of your choice using Azure Arc.

[Arc-enabled AKS](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2271175&clcid=0x409)

![](https://cdn-dynmedia-1.microsoft.com/is/content/microsoftcorp/Features-icons-Card6-kubernetes?resMode=sharp2&op_usm=1.5,0.65,15,0&qlt=85)

### Secure container supply chains

Use trusted Kubernetes solutions in the Azure Marketplace with click-through deployments and flexible billing models.

[Kubernetes apps](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2271176&clcid=0x409)

![](https://cdn-dynmedia-1.microsoft.com/is/content/microsoftcorp/369556-FeatureGrid-Features-Icons-Card7-24x24?resMode=sharp2&op_usm=1.5,0.65,15,0&qlt=85)

### Advanced container networking

Implement enhanced network observability and security features to ensure secure, compliant, and high-performing containerized applications.

[Advanced Container Networking Services](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2301223&clcid=0x409)

![](https://cdn-dynmedia-1.microsoft.com/is/content/microsoftcorp/1028212-FeatureGrid-Features-Icons-Card8-24x24?resMode=sharp2&op_usm=1.5,0.65,15,0&qlt=100)

### Multi-cluster management

Seamlessly manage multiple Kubernetes clusters at scale with Azure Kubernetes Fleet Manager.  

[Fleet Manager](https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/products/kubernetes-fleet-manager/)

Pricing

## Flexible, tier-based pricing to meet your different workload needs

*   Start with the Free tier for experimentation and development and pay only for underlying resources.  
      
    
*   Use the Standard tier for production workloads to access a guaranteed service-level agreement (SLA), scalable Kubernetes control plane, and higher node limits per cluster.  
      
    
*   Upgrade to the Premium tier for workloads requiring long-term support and extended version stability.  
      
    
*   Choose AKS Automatic to deliver production-ready clusters out of the box, with embedded best practices and automated infrastructure operations, including upgrades, node provisioning, scaling, and network configuration.

[See Azure Kubernetes Service pricing](https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/pricing/details/kubernetes-service/)

## 

Frequently asked questions

Expand all

Collapse all

*   01/
    
    ### What is Kubernetes?
    
    Kubernetes is open-source software for deploying and managing containerized applications at scale. It orchestrates a cluster of Azure virtual machines, schedules containers, automatically manages service discovery, incorporates load balancing, tracks resource allocation, and manages the health of individual resources using automatic restart and replication. AKS is a managed service that automates provisioning, upgrading, on-demand scaling, and other Kubernetes management tasks.
    
    [Learn more about Kubernetes](https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/resources/cloud-computing-dictionary/what-is-kubernetes)
    
*   02/
    
    ### What is Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)?
    
    Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) is a fully managed Kubernetes service that simplifies cluster management and reduces operational overhead. It offers automatic scaling for seamless application scaling, enterprise-grade security features, and integration with popular development tools and CI/CD pipelines. AKS ensures high availability with SLA-backed uptime, continuous backups, and automatic maintenance. Additionally, it has a global reach, providing low latency and high performance for applications.
    
    [Learn more about AKS](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2318513&clcid=0x409)
    
*   03/
    
    ### What are the benefits of using Azure Kubernetes Service?
    
    AKS offers the quickest way to start developing and deploying cloud-native and AI-powered apps in Azure, datacenters, or at the edge, with built-in code-to-cloud pipelines and guardrails. As a hosted Kubernetes service, Azure handles critical tasks, like health monitoring and maintenance. You only manage and maintain the agent nodes.
    
*   04/
    
    ### What types of workloads can I run on AKS?
    
    AKS supports a diverse set of containerized workloads, including monoliths and microservices, stateful and stateless, and edge and IoT use cases. You can quickly deploy packaged solutions from Microsoft partners to AKS with Kubernetes apps in the Azure Marketplace to get up and running faster.
    
    [Learn more about Kubernetes apps](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2317823&clcid=0x409)
    
*   05/
    
    ### What deployment options are available to run AKS outside of Azure?
    
    AKS can run in on-premises datacenters or in edge environments, such as a retail store or branch office. Azure Kubernetes Service is enabled by Azure Arc and can be deployed on Azure Stack HCI and on both Windows Server 2019 Datacenter and Windows Server 2022 Datacenter. These flexible deployment options are enabled by Azure Arc and make it quicker to get started hosting Linux and Windows containers in your datacenter or at you edge locations.
    
    [Learn more about hybrid AKS](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2318705&clcid=0x409)
    
*   06/
    
    ### What versions of Kubernetes are supported in Azure Kubernetes Service?
    
    AKS relies on the releases and patches from Kubernetes, an open-source project that supports a sliding window of three minor versions. The Free and Standard tiers of AKS can only guarantee full support while those versions are being serviced. AKS also provides a long-term support (LTS) version of Kubernetes for a two-year period as part of our Premium tier.
    
    [Learn more about LTS](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2318706&clcid=0x409)
    
*   07/
    
    ### Where can I learn more about Azure Kubernetes Service?
    
    [Visit the detailed AKS product FAQ](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2318707&clcid=0x409)
